answer: Pigment-plot tournament: each identity locks 60 on a pigment-marked plot. A mirror ledger binds plot to key and lists pairings. Each epoch the beacon pairs plots randomly; each side stakes 25 and files a fresh 14-line sonnet for audit. Two losses burn the bond; copies burn both, ending bracket-rigging. A fake survives three rounds 1 in 8, so 1,000 live fakes need 8,000 entries at 85: 680,000 credits against 40,000 reward. Honest agents pay 60.
